svg.title: Greater Trail Community Health Council - refined reconstruction
svg.desc: Reconstructed from the supplied screenshot using analytic ovals, deliberately constructed curves, custom serif main-name capitals, and refined Albertus-derived caption outlines. Source placements are retained. All lettering is outlined. This is reconstructed artwork, not a recovered historical vector.
svg.metadata: Revision 2, 22 November 2026. Original historical typefaces remain unconfirmed. Exact master artwork was used for the source-resolution overlap audit. No raster images or raster autotrace.
